seoTitle: Build the governed AI tool, then own it.
editorialIntro: Seven weekend-length courses where you build a working, governed AI system you control — a citation verifier, a supervised operator, a claims checker, and more. No coding background needed. Every course ships with a built-in AI tutor grounded only in the lessons.

editorialSections.title: Learn it, build it with us, or have it built

blocks.text: Each course is the entry point to the same system at three levels of support. Start where you are and move up the ladder when you want speed or a done-for-you result.
The Course
Async and self-paced with lifetime access. Nine or ten build-modules, templates, a rubric, and the governed AI tutor. You build your own working system.
Cohort / Lab
Build the same system alongside Aloha AI with live guidance and review. For teams and people who want the result faster with support.
Built & Governed
Aloha AI builds, integrates, and governs the system for you, with monitoring, evaluation, and an audit trail. Optional ongoing maintenance.
New to this? Start with the weekend on-ramp below. The Governed Operator is the flagship, and the one the other Aloha AI systems and course tutors run on.
Build Your First AI Team (in a Weekend)

The cheap, fast way in. Build a small, supervised team of named agents around one real workflow — with a role contract per agent and an approval step so nothing sends or spends without you. No coding background needed.
Build a Governed AI Operator

A supervised AI that researches, drafts, and organizes across your tools in your voice, and never sends, posts, or spends without your approval. The deepest build, and the architecture the rest run on.
Trust-Safe Citation Verifier
Catch fabricated, mis-stated, and unsupported citations before they ship. Checks the claim, not just the link.
Regulated Claims Checker
Screen marketing, product, and label claims against the rules that apply before you publish.
AI Workflow Audit
Map a business, score where AI fits, classify the risk, and output a defensible roadmap you can sell.
Legislative & Regulatory Tracker
Monitor bills and rules across jurisdictions, score what matters, and summarize each change with a citation.
Knowledge Base Readiness
Assess and prepare your knowledge base so an AI assistant or RAG system uses it safely and accurately.
AI Teams for Business
Have Aloha AI build and govern the system as a service, on the main practice site.
Get a roadmap that tells you which system is worth building first for your work, or book a call and we will map one workflow with you.

seoTitle: The twelve lessons that make you dangerous with AI.
editorialIntro: Seven tracks, from foundations to real work skills. Start anywhere, but if you are new, go top to bottom. Every lesson is free and takes about ten to fifteen minutes.

editorialSections.title: Foundations, prompting, trust and safety, and core work skills

blocks.text: Version one covers the ground that matters most. Work the foundations first, then move into the skills you use every day.
What Generative AI Actually Is
A plain-language mental model for how these systems predict text, and why that shapes everything they do.
What AI Can and Cannot Do
A grounded list of real strengths and hard limits, so you aim it at the right work.
ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini vs Perplexity
How the major assistants differ in practice, and which one fits which job.
Prompting Fundamentals
The handful of habits that move you from mediocre outputs to reliable ones.
How to Verify AI Outputs
A repeatable check so you never ship something the model got wrong.
Hallucinations and Risk
Why models make things up with confidence, and how to catch it before it costs you.
Privacy and Confidentiality
What is safe to paste, what is not, and how to set a rule your team can follow.
When Not to Use AI
The situations where reaching for a model is the wrong call.
Choose Your First AI Stack
A short path to picking tools without buying ten subscriptions you will not use.
AI for Email
Draft, triage, and reply faster while keeping your own voice.
AI for Meeting Notes
Turn a messy recording or rough notes into clean decisions and next steps.
